item.title: Next-generation system container management
item.description: A practical introduction to LXD system containers and virtual machines, including profiles, storage, snapshots, backups, and the security traps worth knowing.

item.title: Hosting a website on the InterPlanetary File System
item.description: Publish a static site to IPFS, pin it, test it through a gateway, and point a human-readable DNSLink name at the current CID.

item.title: Back up OpenPGP keys with Tomb and cryptsetup
item.description: Create an offline OpenPGP primary key, daily-use subkeys, an encrypted Tomb archive, and a separate LUKS2 backup.

item.title: Use a YubiKey for OpenPGP and SSH
item.description: Move OpenPGP signing, encryption, and authentication subkeys to a YubiKey, require touch, and expose the authentication key through gpg-agent for SSH.
